verhaeghe::how many days of notice does.question: How many days of notice does the employer give to terminate a fixed-term contract early after two months?

response.answer: For Bakkerij Verhaeghe, a fixed-term contract can be terminated early during the first half of the contract (and up to the first 6 months) using the notice period of an open-ended contract. Since the employee has two months of seniority (less than 3 months), the employer must give a notice period of 1 week. This notice must be given in writing and starts on the Monday following its notification.
